lead.en: Read a formula as a precise description of a computation. Learn to track domains, compose functions, expand sums, and challenge a claim before translating it into Python.
lead.zh: 把公式读作计算过程的精确描述。学习确定定义域、复合函数、展开求和，并在翻译为 Python 之前检验数学主张。

prerequisites.en: School arithmetic and simple algebra. Use the optional algebra refresher if fractions, signs, equations, or logarithms are unfamiliar. Read the Python primer before the labs; no third-party packages are required.
prerequisites.zh: 需要学校阶段的算术与简单代数。如果分数、符号、方程或对数不熟悉，请先学可选代数复习。实验前阅读 Python 入门；不需要第三方包。

en: Distinguish a definition, an assumption, and a claim.
Read number systems, intervals, and indexed notation without changing their meaning.
State a function's domain, codomain, and image; calculate a composition.
Expand finite sums and products, including empty and nested cases.
Translate a mathematical contract into code and refute a false identity with a counterexample.
zh: 区分定义、假设与待检验的主张。
准确理解数系、区间与下标记法。
明确函数的定义域、陪域与像，并计算复合函数。
展开有限求和与乘积，包括空范围和嵌套情形。
把数学约定翻译成代码，并用反例否定错误恒等式。

title.en: Objects, notation, and a first trace
title.zh: 对象、记法与第一次跟踪

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and answer their checks.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节并完成理解检查。

text.en: Predict, run, and vary Lab 1; explain the indices.
text.zh: 预测、运行并改变实验 1，解释索引。

text.en: Explain equality, assignment, and empty ranges from memory.
text.zh: 凭记忆解释相等、赋值与空范围。
阅读第 3–4 节并探索复合函数。

text.en: Run Lab 2, open the plot, and investigate domain failures.
text.zh: 运行实验 2、打开图像并研究定义域错误。
推导练习 5 的复合函数。

text.en: Read Section 5; expand every displayed sum by hand.
text.zh: 阅读第 5 节，手工展开每个求和表达式。

text.en: Read the notation selection and answer its follow-up.
text.zh: 阅读记法选段并回答后续问题。

text.en: Explain bound and free indices without looking.
text.zh: 不看材料，解释绑定下标与自由下标。
阅读第 6 节与常见误解。

text.en: Run Lab 3; explain each fault and its repair.
text.zh: 运行实验 3，解释每项故障及修复。

text.en: Complete nine choices and one written response.
text.zh: 完成九道选择题与一道书面回答。

text.en: Complete the exit task and check Module 02 readiness.
text.zh: 完成结业任务并检查模块 02 的准备情况。
